user.title: Real2Sim Home
user.description: Rooms from the R2S Capture apps, people located in them with pose and heart / breathing rate. RuView ESP32 CSI nodes send to the UDP port below (set their target_ip to this Home Assistant).

data.forward: Forward RuView packets to (host:port of a RuView sensing server, optional)

abort.already_configured: Real2Sim Home is already set up.

persons.title: People
persons.description: For each person (person|field), optionally pick the sensors that give their room (Bermuda / ESPresense area sensor), heart rate and breathing (fitness band, watch), phone battery and activity. Leave empty to use what is found on their phone / watch devices automatically. People: {people}

upload_room_map.name: Upload room map
upload_room_map.description: Adds or replaces a room from a room_map.json (HOME.md).

remove_room.name: Remove room
remove_room.description: Removes a room and its placements.

set_room_layout.name: Place room on the home plan
set_room_layout.description: Position (metres) and rotation of a room on the home plan.

place.name: Place a device
place.description: Puts a sensor, camera, RuView node (ruview_<id>) or mmWave radar (radar:<prefix>) at a spot in a room.

item.name: Item
item.description: Entity id, ruview_<node id> or radar:<entity prefix>.

x.name: X
x.description: Metres from the room's left edge.

y.name: Y
y.description: Metres from the room's bottom edge.

rotation.name: Rotation
rotation.description: Radar facing direction, degrees counter-clockwise from 'up the map'.
